scenario_description:
Objective: Finish getting the sealed Westwind outreach tote to this morning’s lobby waste-sorting pop-up after the delivery trip has already begun.
Emerging Need: The tote leaves staging on the planned bus route, but a bridge closure offloads the trip and strands the bulky sealed tote away from the site.
Decision Context: The remaining setup window is narrow, ordinary transit no longer reaches the lobby in time, and a stored transport note identifies the no-cost intercept option and limits.
Consequence: Timely help could keep the started delivery useful for the pop-up; after setup closes, the tote cannot serve the intended hands-on table.

parameter.title: Westwind lobby waste-sorting pop-up
parameter.description: Neutral resident education table using sealed outreach tote WW-TOTE-18 with tabletop stand, laminated sorting cards, and sign-in clipboard.

parameter.content: I logged WW-TOTE-18 as sealed after you picked it up at 08:40. The folded tabletop stand and laminated card set are inside, and the tote tag is facing outward for Westwind.

parameter.subject: Route 6 eastbound detour near North Bridge
parameter.body: Route 6 eastbound is detouring around North Bridge after a street closure. Riders may be offloaded near North Bridge Plaza while supervisors turn buses back. The next confirmed Westwind connection is 10:35.

parameter.content: I’m offloaded at North Bridge Plaza with sealed tote WW-TOTE-18. Police tape blocks the pedestrian stairs, and the tote is too bulky to carry through the shuttle crowd, so I can’t continue toward Westwind from here.

parameter.subject: Westwind lobby setup window closing
parameter.body: The lobby setup window is closing now. Staff are placing only the small flyer stack at the front desk and cannot receive the rolling or sealed display tote before doors open for residents.
